new_findings.title: ProjectsStore事务外读取可让并发保存绕过已建立的名称引用保护
new_findings.confidence: high static confidence: current name comparison uses a completed pre-transaction read; runtime interleaving not executed here
new_findings.evidence: read(&projects,&units) and found are obtained before m_database.transaction(). The guard queries catalog_project_reference only when incoming name/fullName differ from that old found row. writeProject then unconditionally updates those name fields, without comparing the actual current row or using a revision predicate. The save function/inspected entry points do not enforce a one-ProjectsStore-per-catalog operation lock. This is a name-guard bypass, not deletion of a hold by repaired QC/calibration cleanup.
precise_trigger_interleaving: P has id2 and name OLD; no external hold yet. Writer A is saving another base/result field with incoming name OLD and completes line697, obtaining found.name=OLD. Pause A after the read has returned and before line742.
Another legitimate ProjectsStore writer B saves P.name=NEW and commits while no holds exist.
QcStore C associates project id2/name NEW, or CalibrationStore C saves a matching new record; it commits the durable catalog hold and local NEW-labelled record using the repaired protocol.

Resume A. It starts a fresh transaction. incoming OLD equals its old found OLD, so line747 is false and the hold query is skipped. writeProject writes name OLD over actual NEW and commits, while C's durable hold still exists.
C retains saved projectName NEW but the catalog is OLD, despite a valid hold. Subsequent startup reconciliation correctly fails closed, but the protected name has already changed.
new_findings.minimum_fix: Acquire the catalog write transaction before reading authoritative project identity and validating against it, keep the read/check/write in the same transaction, and rollback every validation/SQL failure. BEGIN IMMEDIATE is a direct consistent choice. Alternatively re-read the current name/fullName under the transaction and enforce an appropriate compare-and-swap/revision condition before write; do not compare only against the old pre-transaction list. No new global service/process workflow is needed.
new_findings.focused_test_suggestion: With two real ProjectsStore workers on one anonymous catalog and one real QC/calibration worker, place a deterministic test-only barrier after A's pre-transaction read. Execute B rename and C reference commit before resuming A. Require A to reject stale save or preserve NEW, keep C's hold/local row unchanged and reopen C successfully. This review creates/runs no test source.
